title: Half-order quadratic Wasserstein convergence of the Cartesian upwind scheme for globally Lipschitz semiconvex pointy aggregation potentials
author: François Delarue; Frédéric Lagoutière; Nicolas Vauchelet
work: Convergence analysis of upwind type schemes for the aggregation equation with pointy potential
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.30
difficulty_reason: The authors couple consecutive nonlinear numerical marginals to the exact Filippov flow using interpolation-kernel variance, symmetrize the singular interaction through an optimal transport plan, and exploit one-sided semiconvexity to close a quantitative Wasserstein recursion beyond blowup. This measure-valued nonlinear numerical-analysis core exceeds ordinary qualifying examinations.
